meta.name: computer-use
meta.description: OS/window-level inspection and input in visible local app windows through `orca computer`: native apps, external browser windows (Chrome, Edge, Safari), and app webviews. Not for Orca's embedded browser (use `orca-cli`) or page-only automation (use Playwright or CDP).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作本地可见应用窗口,完成点击、输入与界面内容读取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让程序代替你在桌面应用窗口里手动点击和输入。
copy.tagline_en: Automate clicks, typing, and reading content inside visible local app windows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a program to click and type in desktop app windows for you.

howto.what: Claude 会先确定本次会话该用哪个 Orca 可执行文件，再加载与版本匹配的使用指南，然后对本地可见窗口（原生应用、外部浏览器窗口等）做界面检查与输入操作。
howto.when: 当你要在可见的本地应用窗口或外部浏览器窗口（Chrome、Edge、Safari 等）里做窗口级检查或输入时接管；不用于 Orca 内置浏览器和纯页面自动化。

say.text: 看看我当前 Chrome 窗口里显示的是什么
say.note: Claude 先解析本会话的 Orca 可执行文件再操作

say.text: 在那个桌面应用窗口里点一下保存按钮
say.note: 以窗口级方式发送点击输入

say.text: 用 orca computer 列出当前可见的本地窗口
say.note: 使用已解析的可执行文件，不是裸 orca

howto.what_en: Claude first resolves which Orca executable this session should use, loads the version-matched guide, then inspects and sends input to visible local app windows such as native apps and external browser windows.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you need window-level inspection or input in visible local app windows, such as native apps or external Chrome, Edge, Safari windows. Not for Orca's embedded browser or page-only automation.

say_en.text: What's shown in my current Chrome window?
say_en.note: Claude resolves this session's Orca executable first.

say_en.text: Click the Save button in that desktop app window.
say_en.note: Claude sends input at the OS/window level.

say_en.text: List the visible local app windows with orca computer.
say_en.note: Uses the resolved executable, not bare orca.
